claim: Decoda's rate-distortion is competitive with a trivial per-block scalar quantizer at sub-Q4K bit rates
evidence: Per-block scalar (SSE-optimal step) beats Decoda at EVERY rate below ~11 b/w on both real tensors. Native F32 router: scalar 0.068@4.25b/w vs Decoda 0.370@3.95b/w (5.4x worse). Q4_K expert slice: scalar 0.173@3.25b/w vs Decoda 0.389@3.93b/w (2.3x worse at MORE bits). Crossover ~11 b/w, not 4.5
